title: 第13章 醒来第14章 不后悔
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
“我当你为恩人，你却盗取我全身家当，我若不怒，如同木鸡。”
这时大喊声从背后传出，还是那个少年书生气。此刻他气喘吁吁对着的萧飞怒道。
萧飞诧异，虽然这小子境界不低，又傻头傻脑的，但跑得倒是挺快啊。
随后萧飞微笑转头，笑容可掬，看上去也是一副君子模样，甚至伴随着雪花落下，那笑容还有一点迷人，但是此刻对面少年胸口起伏，气不打一处来。
“嘿嘿，气大伤身，这样不好，你儒道的更懂这个道理。”
“还我入院凭证！”
少年书生伸手言道，他在乎就是龙纹印章，不然无法入院。
看着傻乎乎的少年书生，萧飞也是无语了，盗亦有道，原来只要那玩意啊，自己还以为他要和自己打一架呢。
萧飞也不啰嗦，于是一枚印章从白色雾气飞出，属于自己的龙纹印章重新回到少年手中，转身一看萧飞的身影已经无影无踪。
“我在北宣学院等你。”
手握龙纹印章的少年自语，他虽有点迟钝，但不傻，那劲装男子一看就是高手，轻描淡写间不但放倒了数人，还顺手拿走龙纹印章等财物，以后得小心此人才是。
两日后，雪越来越大，道路上的人变得越来越拥挤，寻常家族的少爷，偏远地区的苦修，各种部族的少主，当然也有那些带着些许名气的大教子弟都是应接不暇涌入了北安城。
北安城尽头，高高的峭壁下，偌大的北宣学院内寂静无声，但是北安城城门外却是挤满手握龙纹印章的人。
“排队。”
北宣学院弟子维护着秩序，数条长龙一直蔓延到北安城外，远远望去，北宣学院如同龙门，而这些手持龙纹印章之人都是想要在这龙门攀升。
正午，长龙已经减去一半，但是怀揣着强者梦想的年轻人没有停止脚步。登记之人看着人潮却是纳闷。
“这次招生试练人数看着虽然多，但和以往没法比，至少比以往少了一半，反而是来看热闹的居多，奇怪...”
“咚”的一声，城门处传来巨响，许多人吓了一跳，巡逻的北宣学院弟子当即如临大敌，应声寻去后所有人皆是无语。
“哎呀妈呀，终于到了，俺爹说半个月就到了，可是俺走了一个半月。”
门口站着一个满头大汗且非常圆润的胖子，此人一身貂袍如同棉被般厚沉，大饼般的脸上带着疲惫，在他发愁的模样时候眉眼鼻口几乎凑到了一块。

地面积雪被震飞大片，一个黑乎乎铁锤陷入雪中，在众人惊愕的眼神中，胖子用力拔出铁锤，在众人的惊呼声中，积雪和泥土还有碎石的飞舞中一双愤怒的眼神袭来。
黎心已经火冒三丈，一个上午就有近百人告诉她龙纹印章被盗，自己在追查那个盗贼的同时还教训了几个不知天高地厚的贵族子弟，但是一声巨响，黎心知道麻烦又来了。
随后，四目相对，胖子微笑，摸摸后脑勺很不好意思道：“姐姐，不好意思，我不是故意的，这锤子太重了。”
“交出两颗灵石赔偿，院考报名在那边。”黎心虽然愤怒，但还是告知胖子报名的方向。
“那个谢谢啊，给，还有你生气的样子真美。”圆润的身体抛出两颗灵石一溜烟就消失了，众人无比惊讶，心中纳闷那锤子不是很重吗？
凯凯白雪的城门，黎心也是见多不怪，这几天她算是看到各种形形色色的人，特别是许多大教高层，这让她有种不好的预感...
又是一日后，清晨的朝暮山白雪皑皑，特别是在这初冬季节，山腰山顶雾气缠绕，看上去格外美丽，仿佛就是人间仙境...
“咳...咳。”
床上苍白的少年胸口起伏，两声咳嗽传出，屋外慕容仙儿眼带笑意，暗道终于醒了。
经过七天七夜的昏睡，左丘辰缓缓睁开眼，看着那纵横交错的屋顶，显然是经过个人意见，独特建造的。
“啊~”
一股特疼传来，少年低头，左胸前那黑剑留下的伤口那么醒目，虽然血迹已然凝干。
“忘了他还有致命的剑伤，还好偏离心脏。”
屋外慕容仙儿不好意思言道，自己本就是个大马虎，本以为他没有性命之忧便好，哪知道他无灵力，任何刀割剑刺之伤都是致命的...
强撑着身体，左丘辰起身看着屋内一切，视线通过那破碎的一边看去，一位白衣女子正屋外打坐。
“呵呵，我居然没死！”
“哈哈哈，我居然活着！咳...咳。”
清晨的阳光射入屋内，左丘辰抬头感受着这属于生命的洗礼，感受着这阳光，那是一种久违的重逢。
是劫后余生的证明。
“桌上有水。”

一道不怎么温柔且冰冷的话语传来。
左丘辰呆滞，随后连滚带爬的朝着桌前奔去。
抛开茶杯，直接提起玉瓶豪饮。
对于普通人来说，连续三日不吃饭或许很难受，或许会感觉到那丝被饿到致命的感觉，但其实不然。
人可以数日不进食，但若是数日不饮水那么便会死得更快，故此左丘辰现在就是这样，虽然感觉到腹部无比饥饿，但是首当其冲的却是水...
content_en:
"I regarded you as a benefactor, but you stole all my belongings. If I were not angry, I would be like a wooden chicken."
At this time, the shouting came from behind, and the boy was still bookish. At this moment, he was panting and said angrily to Xiao Fei.
Xiao Fei was surprised. Although this kid was not low-level and stupid, he ran pretty fast.
Then Xiao Fei turned his head with a smile, and he looked like a gentleman. Even with the falling snowflakes, his smile was still a little charming, but at this moment, the boy opposite him had his chest heaving and he was out of breath.
"Hey, it's not good to be angry and hurt your health. You, the Confucian, understand this better."
"Give me back my admission voucher!"
The young scholar stretched out his hand and said that what he cared about was the dragon seal, otherwise he would not be admitted to the hospital.
Looking at the silly young scholar, Xiao Fei was speechless. The thief also had a way. It turned out that he only wanted that thing, and he thought he was going to have a fight with him.
Xiao Fei didn't hesitate, so a seal flew out from the white mist, and his own dragon seal returned to the young man's hands. When he turned around, he saw that Xiao Fei's figure had disappeared.
"I'll wait for you at Bei Propaganda College."
The young man holding the dragon seal said to himself. Although he was a little slow, he was not stupid. The man in the strong suit looked like a master. He not only knocked down several people in an understatement, but also took away the dragon seal and other property. You need to be careful about this person in the future.
Two days later, the snow became heavier and heavier, and the people on the road became more and more crowded. Young masters from ordinary families, ascetics from remote areas, young masters from various tribes, and of course those disciples of great religions with some reputation all poured into Bei'an City.
At the end of Bei'an City, under the high cliffs, the huge Bei Propaganda Academy was silent, but outside the gate of Bei'an City was crowded with people holding dragon seals.
"Get in line."
The disciples of Beixuan College maintained order, and several long dragons spread all the way outside Bei'an City. From a distance, Beixuan College looked like a dragon gate, and these people holding dragon seals all wanted to climb up in this dragon gate.
At noon, the long queue had been reduced by half, but the young man with the dream of becoming a strong man did not stop. The person who registered looked at the crowd and was puzzled.
"Although the number of people in this admissions trial seems to be large, it is incomparable to the past. At least it is less than half of the past. Instead, most of them come to watch the fun. It's strange..."
There was a loud bang at the city gate, and many people were startled. The patrolling Beixuan Academy disciples immediately felt as if they were facing a formidable enemy, and everyone was speechless after they responded to the sound.
"Oh my God, we're finally here. My dad said we'd be here in half a month, but I've been gone for a month and a half."
Standing at the door was a fat man who was sweating profusely and very round. This man was wearing a mink robe as thick as a quilt. His face was as tired as a pie. When he looked worried, his eyebrows, eyes, nose and mouth almost came together.
A large area of ​​snow on the ground was blown away, and a black hammer fell into the snow. In the eyes of everyone's astonishment, the fat man pulled out the hammer with all his strength. In the midst of everyone's exclamations, a pair of angry eyes struck him amid the flying snow, soil and gravel.
Li Xin was already furious. In one morning, nearly a hundred people told her that the dragon seal had been stolen. While tracking down the thief, she also taught a few aristocratic children a lesson, but there was a loud noise and Li Xin knew that trouble was coming again.
Then, their eyes met, the fat man smiled, touched the back of his head and said sheepishly: "Sister, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to do it, this hammer is too heavy."
"Hand over the two spirit stones as compensation. Over there is the registration for the college entrance examination." Although Li Xin was angry, she still told the fat man the direction of registration.
"Thank you, here, and you look so beautiful when you are angry." The round body threw two spiritual stones and disappeared in a flash. Everyone was extremely surprised and wondered, wasn't the hammer very heavy?
Li Xin was not surprised to see so many Kaikai Baixue city gates. She had seen all kinds of people these days, especiallyThey were many high-level university officials, which gave her a bad feeling...
Another day later, Chaomu Mountain in the early morning was covered with snow. Especially in this early winter season, the mountainside and top of the mountain were covered in mist, which looked particularly beautiful, as if it was a fairyland on earth...
"Cough...cough."
The pale boy's chest rose and fell on the bed, and he coughed twice. Outside the room, Murong Xianer's eyes were smiling, secretly saying that he finally woke up.
After seven days and seven nights of sleep, Zuo Qiuchen slowly opened his eyes and looked at the criss-crossing roofs, which were obviously uniquely built with personal opinions.
"Ah~"
A special pain came, and the young man lowered his head. The wound left by the black sword on his left chest was so eye-catching, even though the blood had dried.
"Forgot he still had a fatal sword wound, luckily it was deviated from the heart."
Outside the house, Murong Xian'er was embarrassed to say that she was just a sloppy person. She thought it would be fine if his life was not in danger, but she didn't know that he had no spiritual power and any wound from a knife or a sword would be fatal...
Supporting his body, Zuo Qiuchen stood up and looked at everything in the house. Looking through the broken side, he saw a woman in white meditating outside the house.
"Haha, I'm not dead!"
"Hahaha, I'm actually alive! Cough...cough."
The morning sun shone into the house. Zuo Qiuchen raised his head and felt the baptism of life. Feeling the sunshine, it was a long-lost reunion.
It is the proof of survival after disaster.
"There's water on the table."
A not very gentle and cold word came.
Zuo Qiuchen was stunned, then rolled and crawled towards the table.
Put aside the tea cup and drink directly from the jade bottle.
For ordinary people, not eating for three consecutive days may be uncomfortable, and they may feel that they are starving to death, but this is not the case.
People can go without food for several days, but if they don't drink water for several days, they will die faster. So Zuo Qiuchen is like this now. Although he feels extremely hungry in his abdomen, the first thing he eats is water...
